The progress band now stays a while after the turn ends, and the activity pane no longer blanks out when you send a prompt.

- When a turn ends, the band above the prompt keeps its upper line for 30 seconds with the last step marked done; ✕ at its end closes it early
- New setting `bandAfterTurn` in `/config`: `off`, `10`, `30` (default), `60` or `keep` (until you close it or the next turn starts)
- `/desk-activity` keeps showing the last turn until the new turn calls its first tool, instead of clearing as soon as you send a prompt; turns answered with text only no longer leave the pane stuck on an older turn

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
